findings.reason: if the implemented fold reads the stored answer it computes a different quantity than the 41.9% §2's one-week re-measure compares against, so the re-measure would compare two different metrics.
findings.text: §9(d) defines the fold's second share by the stored answer ("whose answer was acted") but equates it to 41.9%, which the cited research doc defines as the share after a same-type finding whose unit changed between reviews, not whose stored response read "acted"
